title: Unified 2D and 3D Pre-Training of Molecular Representations

problem.claim: Molecular representation learning must capture both 2D molecular graph structure and 3D molecular conformation.

gap.claim: Most previous work handles 2D and 3D molecular information separately.

contributions.claim: A unified 2D and 3D molecular representation pre-training method is proposed.

The method encodes atom coordinates and interatomic distances, fuses them with atomic representations through graph neural networks, and pre-trains on masked reconstruction and cross-modal generation tasks.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The method achieves state-of-the-art results on 10 of 11 downstream molecular property prediction tasks, with an average improvement of 8.3% on 2D-only tasks.
The method achieves significant improvement on two 3D conformation generation tasks.

narrative_sequence.summary: Molecules can be represented as 2D graphs or 3D conformations.
Prior work generally treats 2D and 3D information separately, motivating joint use of both sources.
The work proposes unified 2D and 3D pre-training with graph-neural-network fusion and three pre-training tasks.
The method is evaluated on molecular property prediction and 3D conformation generation tasks, with reported improvements.
